sources.title: LongCat-2.5-Preview launch announcement
sources.evidence: Exact model announcement on September 25, 2026 reports 1.6T parameters, approximately 48B active, 1M context and native multimodality. The normal X page returned 403; the post text, author and date were successfully read through X own oEmbed and syndication endpoints (s2/s3).

sources.title: X oEmbed for the official LongCat-2.5-Preview launch
sources.evidence: First-party embed returns author Meituan LongCat, exact preview name, 1.6T total-size headline, approximately 48B active and September 25, 2026 date.

sources.title: X syndication data for LongCat-2.5-Preview announcement
sources.evidence: Returns matching post ID, Meituan_LongCat author, creation timestamp 2026-09-25T14:16:53.000Z and the exact preview parameter claims. Its attached launch image names LongCat-2.5-Preview but contains no architecture disclosure.

sources.title: LongCat API Platform Change Log
sources.evidence: September 25, 2026 entry explicitly launches LongCat-2.5-Preview with image understanding, coding capabilities and development-agent integrations. Separate 2.0 and 2.0-Preview entries are different releases.

sources.title: LongCat Model Parameters
sources.evidence: Exact preview column sets 1,048,576 total input-plus-output tokens and 262,144 maximum output tokens. Thinking is switchable with enabled/disabled settings. No weight counts or internal architecture appear.

sources.title: LongCat Responses API
sources.evidence: Names LongCat-2.5-Preview as a supported model; documents text and input_image content parts, generated text, reasoning controls, function/custom tools and parallel tool calls.

sources.title: LongCat Retrieve Model reference
sources.evidence: Example for exact preview ID gives context_length 1048576, tools/tool_choice/thinking support and text output. Its text-only input modality example conflicts with the explicit image launch and newer Responses documentation; this is a documentation example, not a live authenticated API read.

sources.title: LongCat API Platform Quick Start Guide
sources.evidence: Lists LongCat-2.5-Preview and LongCat-2.0 as separate agentic API models. Uses rounded 1M context wording; its 128K output limit differs from the exact preview column in the parameter reference.

sources.title: Official Meituan LongCat public model inventory
sources.evidence: Complete returned inventory contains 29 repositories, including LongCat-2.0/BF16, FP8 and INT8 variants, but no LongCat-2.5 or LongCat-2.5-Preview checkpoint. Thus no preview tensor headers or configuration could be counted.

sources.title: Official Meituan LongCat public repository inventory
sources.evidence: Returned organization repositories include LongCat-2.0 and LongCat-DeepResearch, but no exact 2.5 preview repository or model-card release.

sources.title: LongCat AI Platform Terms of Use
sources.evidence: API service terms reserve ownership of model weights, parameters, algorithms, code and framework structure and restrict reverse engineering. Supports proprietary API-service classification; does not establish an open-weight license.

sources.title: LongCat Terms of Use
sources.evidence: Identifies LongCat service operator and affiliates as LongCat/Meituan and explicitly applies supplementary API Platform Terms to API usage.

sources.title: Meituan LongCat research publications
sources.evidence: Current recent-publications page lists post-launch research including QuantMLA and LongCat-DeepResearch, but no exact LongCat-2.5-Preview technical report. Exact-model searches of arXiv, official sites and repositories also did not locate one.

sources.title: QuantMLA: Function-Aligned Dual-Path Quantization for Low-Bit MLA KV Caching
sources.evidence: Post-launch paper discusses LongCat-Flash/2.0 and tests LongCat-Flash-Lite among MLA models. Full HTML contains no exact LongCat-2.5 reference, so its structural details cannot establish preview architecture.

sources.title: LongCat-DeepResearch Technical Report
sources.evidence: Post-launch report concerns a research system based on an enhanced LongCat-2.0 model; full HTML contains no exact LongCat-2.5 reference. It does not disclose this preview architecture.

name.note: Exact API model name, including Preview suffix. No separate stable LongCat-2.5 revision is established by the checked sources.

developer.note: Official Meituan LongCat announcement and first-party service identity establish developer attribution.

family.note: Normalized family label for the officially named LongCat model series.

release_date.note: Exact preview launch date in both official announcement and dated changelog; not a later gateway listing date or the distinct 2.0 release.

open_weights.note: Public offering is API/chat access. Checked official model and repository inventories contain no exact preview checkpoint or open-weight release; absence is bounded to these current public surfaces.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the closed API service under LongCat Platform Terms. The MIT licenses of released LongCat-2.0 checkpoints do not apply to this preview by inference.

parameters_b.note: Developer headline 1.6T equals nominal 1600 billion; this is not an independently counted complete checkpoint. No exact preview tensors/config are public in checked inventories, so vision, embeddings, MTP, ties, buffers or quantization components cannot be reconciled.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer announcement says approximately 48B active for this exact preview. Approximate nominal figure; the post does not define component inclusion or activation-phase accounting.

architecture.note: Checked exact-preview announcement/API sources do not explicitly disclose internal architecture. Later research inspected does not name 2.5. Sparse active-vs-total counts suggest conditional computation but do not establish the catalog architecture label; 2.0 MoE/LSA/N-gram details and shared site metadata are not transferred.

context_window.note: Exact documented API maximum for combined input and output is 1,048,576. This is serving context, not independently established pretraining length or a YaRN extension. Quick Start rounds to 1M; no separate default/extension is specified. Parameter reference allows 262,144 output, while Quick Start still says 128K.

modalities.note: Explicit image-understanding launch and input_image documentation support image input alongside text; output is text. Retrieve Model example still lists text-only input, an acknowledged documentation conflict; no paid endpoint test was performed. No exact-model audio/video generation claim is added.

reasoning.note: Optional thinking enabled/disabled and reasoning controls are documented for the exact preview.

tool_call.note: Official supported-model and API documentation expose function/custom tools, tool-choice and parallel calls.

description.value: Meituan's multimodal reasoning model for coding and agent tasks, with image understanding and a 1M-token context window
description.note: Existing description is supported as a capability summary; 1M is rounded marketing notation for the exact 1,048,576-token serving limit, not an independently tested benchmark claim.

patch.notes: Exact LongCat-2.5-Preview API release, September 25, 2026. Meituan launch announcement reports nominal 1.6T total parameters and approximately 48B active; neither figure is a complete learned-tensor count. No public exact-preview checkpoint or internal architecture disclosure was located in checked official repositories, API docs and later research; LongCat-2.0 architecture/MIT licensing are not transferred. API context is 1,048,576 total input-plus-output tokens. The parameter reference gives 262,144 maximum output while Quick Start retains 128K. Image input is explicit in the launch and Responses API, despite a text-only Retrieve Model example. API access is proprietary; optional thinking and tool calls are documented, not live-tested.

summary: Verified exact-preview nominal counts of 1600B total and approximately 48B active from Meituan own September 25 announcement, recovered via first-party X embed/syndication. Correct context to 1,048,576 and classify API license as proprietary. Release date, identity, image/text input, text output, optional thinking and tools are confirmed by official documentation. Architecture remains undisclosed in checked exact-model sources; no public preview checkpoint was found, so no learned-tensor count or sibling architecture transfer is justified. Documentation conflicts on image examples and output limits are recorded.
